target_customer: Shippers, warehouses, distribution centers and carriers that run loading docks and yards
problem: Dock appointments, driver check-in and yard tracking run on spreadsheets, phone calls and disconnected tools, which causes long dwell times and no accountability.
business_model: B2B SaaS, modular pay-as-you-grow pricing for dock scheduling, check-in and yard management

founders.name: Conrad Lilleness
founders.background_notes: YC page and the seed press release name him as founder and CEO; neither gives background. The YC page does not name another co-founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Appointment scheduling, QR check-in and yard logs are standard web and mobile software; the harder part is integrations with WMS, TMS and EDI systems.

defensibility.rationale: Scheduling software is copyable, but integrations with warehouse systems and carrier networks add some switching cost once a site is live.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitor listings today show Opendock, GoRamp, Velostics and SAP Yard Logistics as alternatives; no source shows any of them copying or buying Conduit. These listings are not dated to 2023.

market_need_then: Warehouse dock and yard operations were largely manual (spreadsheets, phone calls) per the company's own positioning. No dated 2023 demand source was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses helloconduit.com rather than conduit.com; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Practical, operations focused, with demo and self-guided tour calls to action.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is shared with many unrelated companies (search results for it return a data tool, a crypto rollup firm and others), and no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Conduit is active and, per its YC page, reports 100+ customers, 172% net revenue retention and zero churn on a team of under 20. It closed a $6M seed led by Innovation Endeavors in March 2026, roughly three years after the Winter 2023 batch, which suggests slow but real traction in a niche with several competitors. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news was found.
notes: Competition list left empty: only undated 2026 review-site listings (G2, Software Advice) exist. Founding year 2023 per YC; one directory says 2022. A startupintros 2024 'seed extension' entry could not be tied to this company and is ignored. Round date comes from briefglance article dateline; the iwla copy confirms the amount only. No info on a pre-2026 round was found, so coverage is partial.
